notes: §1985:X.5.2.3 SR1: "Literal-1 must be a nonnumeric literal." CallBinder#BindCall reads literal-1 through Literal1Of and ProgramName, whose one reader ProgramNameLiteral#Form refuses (COBOL1627) any operand that is not an alphanumeric/national string literal; the 2002+ literal forms are refused at 85 by their own edition rows, so at 85 only a nonnumeric literal names a program. Probes at --std 85: "SUBP" and "SUBP    " call the program; 123 (witness), 1.5, -1, ZERO, SPACE, QUOTE and ALL "SUBP" refused COBOL1627; N"SUBP", X"53554250" and "SU" & "BP" refused COBOL0900; "" refused COBOL0900 and COBOL1627. The messages cite §2023:14.9.4.3 SR2 rather than the 1985 rule (wording only).

next.reason: 1985: "Literal-1 must be a nonnumeric literal."; 2023: "Literal-1 shall be an alphanumeric or national literal and shall not be a zero-length literal.". 2023 also allows a national literal as the CALL literal-1, a case 1985 did not have. The zero-length exclusion adds no restriction, since 1985 had no zero-length literal.
